name: Build SecureNet APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [securenet]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - name: Decode image assets (base64 -> files)
        run: |
          mkdir -p assets/images
          for f in assets_b64/*.b64; do
            out="assets/images/$(basename "$f" .b64)"
            base64 -d "$f" > "$out"
            echo "decoded $out ($(stat -c%s "$out") bytes)"
          done

      - name: Download flag icons (flagcdn)
        run: |
          mkdir -p assets/flags
          # 1x1 transparent placeholder so the asset dir is never empty
          printf 'iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNkYAAAAAYAAjCB0C8AAAAASUVORK5CYII=' | base64 -d > assets/flags/_placeholder.png
          for code in jp kr us gb de fr ca au sg nl ch se es it ru br in id vn th ph my hk tw nz at be dk fi no pl cz hu ro ua tr gr pt ie mx ar za eg il sa ae pk bd lk np mm kh uz kz; do
            curl -sfL --max-time 20 "https://flagcdn.com/w160/${code}.png" -o "assets/flags/${code}.png" || echo "flag $code unavailable"
          done
          ls assets/flags | wc -l

      - name: Scaffold android project (template from installed Flutter)
        run: |
          flutter create --project-name securenet --org com.pyaystudios --platforms android scaffold_tmp
          cp -r scaffold_tmp/android android
          rm -rf scaffold_tmp

      - name: Patch scaffold (applicationId, minSdk, Impeller off, VPN packaging)
        run: python3 ci/post_scaffold.py

      - name: Pub get
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Generate launcher icons
        run: dart run flutter_launcher_icons

      - name: Build release APK (debug-signed test build)
        run: flutter build apk --release

      - name: Publish APK to release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk securenet.apk
          ls -la securenet.apk
          gh release view securenet-vpn >/dev/null 2>&1 || gh release create securenet-vpn --title "SecureNet VPN (test build)" --notes "Automated test build from the securenet branch. Live VPN Gate servers; no ads in build 1."
          gh release upload securenet-vpn securenet.apk --clobber

      - name: Upload artifact (backup)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: securenet-apk
          path: securenet.apk
